question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a gold present, Bob has a red present, and Claire has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) gold present
(B) red present
(C) teal present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (gold, red, teal)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (red, gold, teal)
2. Claire and Alice swap: (teal, gold, red)
3. Claire and Bob swap: (teal, red, gold)
Claire has the gold present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
